Bus Collides With Train Near Channel Tunnel, 19 Injured

A minibus carrying truck drivers collided with a train near the Channel Tunnel entrance on the French side. At least 19 people were injured in the incident. Two individuals were airlifted to a hospital, though no life-threatening injuries were reported. The truck drivers were reportedly heading to travel on a LeShuttle train through the tunnel.
